messages:
tess: Quick follow-up from yesterday's authz outage. Root cause: rotation job skipped namespaces after the config cleanup. Need owners for automation, alerts, and runbook updates.

alex: Agreed. Minimal plan: 1) make rotation idempotent + add canary, 2) add recurring audit & alerts for long-lived tokens, 3) update runbook + manual remediation checklist.

sophie: I'll take the audit/alerts (RD-601). Draft Splunk query + pager policy by 2026-03-26. Will surface a dashboard tile for tokens >60d TTL.

cj: I'll own rotation automation (RD-600). Tasks: idempotent runner, canary flow, success/failure metric, CI e2e simulating namespace-regex drift. Target: 2026-04-03.

tess: I'll update runbook and do manual rotations tonight for affected services (RD-602). ETA 2026-03-25 for runbook.

incident-bot: Created tickets: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/zz-authz  (RD-600, RD-601, RD-602).

cj: Manual rotation logs so far: ```svc-payments -> ok
svc-billing -> ok
svc-logger -> failed: legacy secret path```

sophie: svc-logger uses /secret/keymaster/legacy. I'll open infra ticket to remap and add that service to the audit scope.

security-eng: I'm running a quick scan for services using legacy paths and tokens with TTL>60d. Will attach CSV to the board by EOD.

alex: Add alert rule: rotation_failure_count > 0 for 2 consecutive runs and a recurring audit that flags TTL>60d. Also add a blocker label for any service referencing legacy secret paths.

sophie: Splunk WIP: ```index=auth_logs sourcetype=token | where ttl_days>60 OR secret_path LIKE "/secret/keymaster/legacy%" | stats count by service, token_id``` Will refine.

cj: I'll instrument rotation job metric (rotations_success, rotations_failures) and make CI block merges if e2e detects missed namespaces. PR 4472.

tess: Manual rotations completed after infra remap. Logs: ```svc-payments ok
svc-billing ok
svc-logger ok```

alex: Scheduling a short sync Mon 2026-03-30 09:00 PT to confirm progress. Target closure by 2026-04-12 if remediations pass. Thanks all.
